AI/ML excels at detecting patterns in large datasets, such as sales data. Machine learning models can identify trends, make forecasts, and provide actionable insights, making this a highly practical use case.

Translating speech into text in real-time

Real-time speech-to-text translation is a well-established AI/ML application. Using natural language processing (NLP) and speech recognition algorithms, AI systems can accurately transcribe spoken language into text in real-time, making this a viable and valuable use case.

References:

https://aws.amazon.com/machine-learning/ai-use-cases

questions.text: Your organization is in a race to bring a new generative AI-based product to market, but the development team is concerned about the time required to build models from scratch. How can AWS generative AI services help speed up time to market?

options.text: By offering the ability to manage on-premises hardware for generative AI.
By offering pay-as-you-go pricing for computational resources.
By allowing full customization of models with no predefined templates.
By providing pre-trained foundation models and an integrated environment for rapid prototyping.

questions.explanationHtml:
Correct

By providing pre-trained foundation models and an integrated environment for rapid prototyping.

AWS offers services like Amazon Bedrock, which provides pre-trained foundation models (FMs) that developers can use directly without starting from scratch. These FMs are designed for various generative AI tasks, such as text generation, image creation, and more. AWS allows developers to quickly fine-tune and customize these models to suit specific business needs, reducing the time and effort needed for training from the ground up. Additionally, AWS provides integrated environments for rapid prototyping, such as Amazon SageMaker, which helps teams quickly test, refine, and deploy AI applications. This saves development teams time and accelerates the product‘s launch to market.

Incorrect

By allowing full customization of models with no predefined templates.

Starting without predefined templates or models would actually increase development time, as teams would have to build everything from scratch. AWS services focus on speeding up development by offering pre-built, customizable models.

By offering pay-as-you-go pricing for computational resources.

While AWS does offer flexible pricing models, such as pay-as-you-go for its compute resources, this feature mainly helps with cost management, not necessarily speeding up time to market. It is a financial benefit rather than a time-saving feature.

By offering the ability to manage on-premises hardware for generative AI.

Managing on-premises hardware doesn't directly contribute to faster time to market. In fact, AWS primarily focuses on cloud-based solutions for generative AI, removing the need to manage hardware manually.

References:

https://aws.amazon.com/bedrock

https://aws.amazon.com/sagemaker

questions.text: A global enterprise is utilizing a generative AI model to automate customer service across various regions and domains, such as chat support, email responses, and phone assistance. To assess how well the AI performs across these diverse areas, which metric is most relevant?
questions.explanationHtml:
Correct

Cross-domain performance

Cross-domain performance refers to how well an AI model operates across different areas, such as chat support, email responses, and phone assistance. For a global enterprise using AI for customer service, it‘s essential that the AI works effectively in all regions and domains. Measuring cross-domain performance ensures the AI can handle various customer needs, languages, and support channels, maintaining consistent quality and user experience across the board. This metric is particularly relevant in this scenario because it evaluates the model‘s adaptability and robustness in diverse environments.

Incorrect

Efficiency

Efficiency measures how fast the AI can complete tasks, like resolving customer queries. It doesn't provide insight into how well the AI performs across different channels or regions, making it less relevant in assessing cross-domain functionality.

Average revenue per user

Average revenue per user (ARPU) measures the financial performance of a business but is not relevant for evaluating the technical performance of a customer service AI. It focuses on revenue, not the AI's capabilities.

Accuracy

Accuracy measures how correctly the AI answers customer queries. While crucial, it does not account for how the AI adapts across different domains, regions, or communication methods, which is the focus of cross-domain performance.

References:

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/canvas-metrics.html

questions.text: Your organization is concerned about preventing unauthorized changes to the AI models and infrastructure in use. Which of the following best practices would you implement to detect vulnerabilities and ensure infrastructure protection?

options.text: Disable all logging to avoid overhead
Allow unrestricted access to model endpoints
Perform regular vulnerability management using Amazon Inspector
Store encryption keys locally on developer machines

questions.explanationHtml:
Correct

Perform regular vulnerability management using Amazon Inspector

Amazon Inspector helps with automated security assessments, identifying vulnerabilities and deviations from best practices in your AWS infrastructure. By performing regular vulnerability scans with Amazon Inspector, you can detect security issues such as exposed ports, unpatched software, and misconfigurations that could allow unauthorized access to AI models or infrastructure. This best practice helps ensure your system remains protected and resilient against threats.

Incorrect

Disable all logging to avoid overhead

Disabling logging would hinder your ability to monitor and track potential security incidents. Logging is essential for auditing, detecting, and responding to unauthorized changes.

Allow unrestricted access to model endpoints

Allowing unrestricted access to model endpoints exposes your AI system to potential security threats. It's crucial to implement access control and restrict access to authorized users.

Store encryption keys locally on developer machines

Storing encryption keys locally is a security risk, as it increases the chances of unauthorized access. Keys should be securely managed using AWS services like AWS KMS.

References:

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html

questions.text: An organization needs to analyze and extract key data fields from scanned documents, such as invoices and receipts, for further processing. Which AWS service is best suited for this task?
questions.explanationHtml:
Correct

Amazon Textract

Amazon Textract is an AI service designed for extracting text, handwriting, and other data from scanned documents, such as invoices, receipts, and forms. It goes beyond simple optical character recognition (OCR) by not only identifying text but also automatically detecting key data fields such as dates, totals, and line items. Textract enables organizations to automate document processing tasks and integrate the extracted data into their workflows for further processing.

Incorrect

Amazon Polly

Amazon Polly is a text-to-speech service that converts written text into natural-sounding speech. It is not designed for extracting data from scanned documents.

Amazon SageMaker

Amazon SageMaker is a machine learning platform for building, training, and deploying ML models. It is not specifically designed for document data extraction like Textract.

AWS Glue

AWS Glue is an ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) service that helps prepare and transform structured and semi-structured data. It is not used for extracting data from scanned documents.

References:

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/textract/latest/dg/what-is.html

questions.text: A financial services company is using a model that generates embeddings for transaction data, and they need a relational database that supports PostgreSQL extensions to store these embeddings. Which AWS service should they choose?
questions.explanationHtml:
Correct

Amazon RDS

Amazon RDS (Relational Database Service) is a fully managed service that makes it easy to set up, operate, and scale relational databases in the cloud. It supports multiple database engines, including PostgreSQL. For a financial services company that needs a relational database supporting PostgreSQL extensions to store embeddings from transaction data, Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL is the ideal choice. It allows the use of PostgreSQL extensions, enabling advanced functionalities such as custom data types, indexing methods, and stored procedures. This flexibility is essential for handling complex data like embeddings. Additionally, Amazon RDS provides automated backups, software patching, and high availability through Multi-AZ deployments, which are crucial features for maintaining data integrity and uptime in financial applications. The service also offers encryption at rest and in transit, enhancing the security of sensitive transaction data.

Incorrect

Amazon DynamoDB

Amazon DynamoDB is a NoSQL database service designed for key-value and document data structures. It doesn‘t support SQL queries or PostgreSQL extensions, making it unsuitable for applications requiring relational database features.

Amazon Redshift

Amazon Redshift is a fully managed data warehousing service optimized for complex analytical queries on large datasets. While it‘s based on PostgreSQL, it doesn‘t support all PostgreSQL extensions and is not ideal for transaction processing or storing embeddings in a relational model.

Amazon Neptune

Amazon Neptune is a managed graph database service optimized for storing and querying highly connected data. It doesn‘t support relational database models or PostgreSQL extensions, so it‘s not suitable for the company‘s requirements.

References:

https://aws.amazon.com/rds/postgresql

questions.text: You are leading the selection of an AI model for real-time translation services. Given the model‘s heavy resource requirements, which of the following practices would help reduce the environmental impact while maintaining acceptable performance?

options.text: Train the model more frequently to keep it updated.
Deploy the model on a dedicated server with no resource sharing.
Use edge computing to reduce data transmission and energy consumption.
Increase the dataset size to enhance model accuracy, regardless of resource usage.

questions.explanationHtml:
Correct

Use edge computing to reduce data transmission and energy consumption.

Using edge computing means processing data closer to where it is generated or needed, rather than relying solely on centralized cloud servers. By deploying the AI model on edge devices, such as local servers or user devices, you can reduce the amount of data transmitted over networks. This decreases latency, which is crucial for real-time translation services, and reduces the energy consumption associated with data transmission and centralized data processing. Edge computing can also lower the environmental impact by minimizing the reliance on large data centers, which consume significant amounts of energy and contribute to carbon emissions. Additionally, processing data on edge devices can enhance privacy and security by keeping sensitive information local. By adopting edge computing, you balance maintaining acceptable performance in your translation services with reducing the environmental footprint of your AI model.

Incorrect

Train the model more frequently to keep it updated

Training the model more often increases computational load and energy usage, which can actually heighten environmental impact rather than reduce it.

Deploy the model on a dedicated server with no resource sharing

Using a dedicated server without resource sharing can lead to underutilized resources and increased energy consumption, making it less environmentally friendly.

Increase the dataset size to enhance model accuracy, regardless of resource usage

Expanding the dataset size may improve accuracy but also requires more computational power and energy for training, which increases environmental impact.

References:

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/latest/sustainability-pillar/sustainability-pillar.html

https://aws.amazon.com/edge

questions.text: A marketing team wants to use generative AI to create personalized product descriptions. They are trying to determine the model's effectiveness. Which business metric is most appropriate for evaluating the success of their generative AI solution?

options.text: Number of customer queries resolved by the generative model.
Cross-domain performance of the generative model.
Conversion rate improvement due to personalized content.
Average number of tokens used in product descriptions.

questions.explanationHtml:
Correct

Conversion rate improvement due to personalized content.

Measuring the conversion rate improvement due to personalized content is the most appropriate business metric for evaluating the success of the generative AI solution in this scenario. Conversion rate directly reflects the percentage of visitors who take a desired action, such as making a purchase, after viewing the personalized product descriptions. By analyzing the change in conversion rates before and after implementing the generative AI solution, the marketing team can assess how effectively the personalized descriptions are influencing customer behavior and driving sales. This metric provides clear, quantifiable insights into the return on investment (ROI) of the AI initiative and aligns closely with the team‘s objectives of enhancing customer engagement and increasing revenue.

Incorrect

Average number of tokens used in product descriptions.

Focusing on the average number of tokens (words) used in product descriptions measures the length of the content but does not provide insights into its effectiveness in driving customer actions. While content length can impact readability and engagement, it does not directly correlate with conversion rates.

Cross-domain performance of the generative model.

Cross-domain performance refers to the model‘s ability to perform well across different domains or subject areas. In this context, the marketing team is primarily concerned with the model‘s performance in generating effective product descriptions within their specific domain. Evaluating cross-domain performance would not provide relevant information about the model‘s impact on their conversion rates.

Number of customer queries resolved by the generative model.

The number of customer queries resolved by the generative model pertains to its effectiveness in customer support scenarios, such as answering questions or troubleshooting issues. This metric is not relevant to the marketing team‘s goal of creating personalized product descriptions to improve conversion rates. As such, it does not serve as an appropriate measure of the success of their generative AI solution in this specific application.

questions.text: A healthcare company needs to store patient medical records using an AI system on AWS, and encryption is required both at rest and in transit. Which AWS service should you use to manage encryption keys for securing this data?
questions.explanationHtml:
Correct

AWS Key Management Service (KMS)

AWS Key Management Service (KMS) allows you to easily create and manage encryption keys used to encrypt your data at rest and in transit. With AWS KMS, you can manage the lifecycle of encryption keys, control their usage, and apply role-based access to ensure that only authorized users can access encrypted data. For healthcare data, which requires strict compliance with regulations like HIPAA, KMS provides a scalable and secure way to handle encryption, ensuring that both data at rest and in transit are protected.

Incorrect

Amazon Inspector

Amazon Inspector is a security assessment service that helps improve the security and compliance of applications deployed on AWS. It identifies vulnerabilities but does not manage encryption keys for securing data.

Amazon Macie

Amazon Macie helps with identifying and classifying sensitive data, such as personal and healthcare information, but it is not used for managing encryption keys or directly securing data at rest or in transit.

AWS Config

AWS Config helps you monitor and assess the configurations of your AWS resources. It does not provide encryption or key management capabilities for securing data.

References:

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/overview.html

questions.text: A machine learning model achieves 95% accuracy in predicting customer churn, but the company notices that it misses a significant number of actual churns. What performance metric would help them better evaluate the balance between precision and recall?
questions.explanationHtml:
Correct

F1 score

The F1 score is a metric that combines both precision and recall to give a single performance measure. It is the harmonic mean of precision (how many of the predicted positive cases were actually positive) and recall (how many of the actual positive cases were correctly predicted). The F1 score is particularly useful in situations where there is an imbalance between the classes or when missing certain positive cases (like actual churns) is more critical than getting all predictions correct. In this scenario, where the model achieves high accuracy but misses many actual churn cases, the F1 score helps better evaluate the balance between precision and recall, giving a more comprehensive understanding of the model‘s performance on the minority class (churn).

Incorrect

Accuracy

Accuracy measures the overall correctness of the model but can be misleading when dealing with imbalanced datasets. It doesn't account for how well the model balances precision and recall.

ROC AUC

ROC AUC evaluates the model's ability to distinguish between classes across different thresholds, but it doesn‘t directly provide information about the balance between precision and recall.

Specificity

Specificity measures the proportion of true negatives that are correctly identified, focusing on how well the model identifies non-churn cases. While useful, it does not address the balance between precision and recall, which is the primary concern in this case.

References:

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/machine-learning/latest/dg/multiclass-model-insights.html

questions.text: Your team needs a foundation model for image recognition tasks. The input and output sizes are expected to vary significantly, and your primary concern is how efficiently the model can handle long inputs and outputs. What selection criterion should you prioritize?
questions.explanationHtml:
Correct

Input/output length

Input/output length refers to how well a model can handle long or complex inputs and outputs, which is crucial for image recognition tasks. In scenarios where the input size (image resolution) or output (such as a detailed image label or segmentation map) varies greatly, the model must be capable of efficiently processing these variations without sacrificing performance. If the model struggles with larger inputs/outputs, it may become slow, inaccurate, or even fail to process the data. Therefore, you should prioritize models that can handle long input/output sizes well. This ensures that the model can scale effectively for different image resolutions and maintain consistent performance, especially in high-demand environments.

Incorrect

Model size

While smaller models can be more efficient, prioritizing model size alone does not address the need to handle varying input/output lengths. A smaller model may struggle with larger inputs and outputs.

Customization capability

Customization can improve performance for specific tasks, but the primary concern here is the ability to handle long inputs and outputs. Customization alone won‘t solve inefficiency in input/output handling.

Cost-effectiveness

While important, cost-effectiveness should be considered after ensuring the model can efficiently handle the varying input/output lengths required for your tasks.
